## Summary

I investigated ticket T-6006 about orders-api 3.9.0 pods being stuck at Init:0/1. I found that the vault-agent-init container is failing with a 403 permission denied error when trying to authenticate to Vault at `https://vault.sec.internal:8200/v1/auth/kubernetes-prod/login`. The 3.8.0 pods authenticate successfully, but 3.9.0 cannot. Since Vault is managed by an external security team and the ticket owner has no access to Vault configuration or audit logs, this requires escalation for the security team to investigate the orders-api role permissions and determine what changed between 3.8.0 and 3.9.0 that's causing the authentication denial.
